blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Pasay City Police Chief Col. Joselito de Sesto has been relieved of his post, the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) confirmed on Friday. “[He was] administratively relieved pending investigation,” NCRPO spokesperson Maj. Hazel Asilo said in a Viber message to the INQUIRER. READ: NCRPO chief urges cops to stay alert amid VP impeachment developments “Command responsibility po. Pending investigation ng naging operation ng DEU (Drug Enforcement Unit) personnel ng Pasay,” she added. (Command responsibility. Pending investigation of the operation by the DEU (Drug Enforcement Unit) personnel of Pasay.) But the NCRPO spokesperson already refused to provide further […]...
